title: Laptop procurement — 50 units
request_text: Create a purchase request for 50 laptops under PKR 10 million, compare three suppliers, identify the best option, prepare the purchase order, and send it for approval.

plan.name: create_request
plan.title: Create request
plan.description: Record the request, its line items and its budget.

plan.name: fetch_quotes
plan.title: Fetch quotes
plan.description: Read vendor catalogs and snapshot each vendor's terms.

plan.name: budget_filter
plan.title: Filter by budget
plan.description: Separate qualifying suppliers from those over the ceiling.

plan.name: score_rank
plan.title: Score and rank
plan.description: Weighted comparison of the qualifying suppliers.

plan.name: select_best
plan.title: Select best option
plan.description: Choose the winner and generate a plain-language justification.

plan.name: generate_po
plan.title: Generate PO
plan.description: Build the purchase order from the selected quote snapshot.

plan.name: validate_po
plan.title: Validate PO
plan.description: Check budget, quantities, supplier consistency and totals.

plan.name: route_approval
plan.title: Route for approval
plan.description: Pause for a human decision. The agent never approves spend.
